note: Mix recipes: the gain each voice of a section gets ON TOP of the run's phase mix (content/run/run.json stages: drums alone, bass reveal, ...). A recipe never replaces the phase mix, it scales it, so the gameplay stays; every value is 0 to 1 and the bass never drops under 0.5 (the reveal must stay audible). Used by tools/content/arrange.py, RunData (RunAudio plays them) and the chapter render (baked into the stems).
